newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC tenders to sell Jan-Jun 1997 gas oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC tenders to sell Jan-Jun 1997 gas oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned, Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a term tender to sell four to six cargoes of 225,000-250,000 barrels of gas oil each between January and June 1997, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender to sell the 0.3-percent sulphur grade gas oil will close on December 10 and is valid until December 13, sources said.
A CPC source said the actual export volumes will depend on the bidding levels. If prices were high, CPC might award two contracts, the source said.
CPC first started exporting diesel by six-monthly tenders this year. It regularly issues spot monthly sale tenders.
In its previous spot tender for December 11-30 lifting, CPC sold three 225,000-to-250,000-barrel diesel cargoes at $29.92 per barrel, free-on-board Kaohsiung.
